name: Harvey Beaks
description: A mild-mannered young bird and his best friends, a pair of rambunctious siblings called Fee and Foo, seek adventure and mischief in the magical forest that they call home.

videos.title: Pe-Choo!
videos.overview: To have an awesome time at the lake, Harvey has to do the one thing that's the hardest for him: get in really big trouble.

videos.title: The Spitting Tree
videos.overview: The kids spit from the highest tree in Littlebark until they realize they can't get back down.

videos.title: The Finger
videos.overview: The discovery of a giant, stone finger in the ground leads the kids on a passionate quest to find out what's attached to the rest of it.

videos.title: The Negatives of Being Positively Charged
videos.overview: When Fee and Foo become magnetized, nature seems determined to force them apart.

videos.title: The Rentl Bike
videos.overview: Harvey and Foo rent a bike from a grumpy shopkeeper and learn the meaning of the phrase "Buyer Beware."

videos.title: Anti-Valentine's Day
videos.overview: Always excluded from Valentine's Day festivities, Fee makes up her own holiday called Anti-Valentine's Day.

videos.title: Nightclub Night
videos.overview: It's all-ages night at the club and Harvey can't wait to blow everyone's minds with his rad dance moves.

videos.title: The Rebel
videos.overview: Harvey becomes convinced that he's a rebel… even though he has no idea what being a rebel means.

videos.title: Harvey's First Scar
videos.overview: Envious of Fee and Foo's cool scars, Harvey asks them to give him a scar of his own. He just doesn't realize that getting hurt is part of the process.

videos.title: A Tail of Les Squirrels
videos.overview: The kids find a detached tail in the woods and decide to keep it.

videos.title: The Nature of Nature
videos.overview: Harvey goes on a heroic crusade to stop the spread of chaos in the forest.

videos.title: Princess Is Better Than You
videos.overview: Tired of seeing Princess unfairly win at everything, Harvey and his friends try to teach her a lesson.

videos.title: Old-Fashioned Dade
videos.overview: Dade is thrilled to hang with Harvey at the yearly Old-Fashioned Days festival.

videos.title: Someone's Stealing My Stuff
videos.overview: Fee and Foo instantly get blamed when everyone's stuff goes missing. In order to protect his friends, Harvey searches to find the real culprit.

videos.title: Comet Night? (1)
videos.overview: Harvey tries to have a magical night of bonding with his father, but everything goes horribly, horribly wrong.

videos.title: Comet Night! (2)
videos.overview: Miriam tries to prove that she's still got excitement in her veins by taking Fee and the girls out for a wild night.

videos.title: The Almighty Foo
videos.overview: When Foo accidentally destroys a bug village, he tries to make it up by giving them a safe, new home: Harvey's house.

videos.title: The Ghost Problem
videos.overview: Fee's prejudices against ghosts gets her into a mess of trouble with the local ghost librarian.

videos.title: The Sleepover's Over
videos.overview: The twins invite Harvey over for a sleepover, but there's just one problem: Harvey has NEVER made it all the way through a sleepover before.

videos.title: Certified Babysitter
videos.overview: After earning a babysitting badge, Harvey is determined to prove he can babysit his little sister all on his own.

videos.title: Fee's Haircut
videos.overview: After Fee gets her first ever haircut, she has to decide what's better: looking awesome or being awesome.

videos.title: Harvey's Favorite Book
videos.overview: Harvey feels jealous when all the kids fall in love with his favorite detective book series.

videos.title: Dad Band
videos.overview: Harvey helps his father's garage band hit the big-time, but when the band's egos get out of control, it's up to Harvey to bring them back down to earth.

videos.title: Foo's Panic Room
videos.overview: Afraid that everyone wants to steal his favorite berries, Foo locks himself and the fruit away in a box.

videos.title: A Day of No To-Do
videos.overview: When Harvey goes overboard with his new day-planner, Fee tries to show him that the best-laid plans are sometimes the least-planned ones.

videos.title: Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: Harvey enlists the help of the twins to cook a big, fancy dinner for his parents.

videos.title: Randl's Scandl
videos.overview: When Randl decides to cut ties with his mother, Fee and Foo have to make him see how perfect a mother she really is.

videos.title: King of Pranks
videos.overview: Harvey pulls off a prank on Littlebark Grove, but by not wanting to upset anyone with the truth, he has to keep it going.

videos.title: Night Maid
videos.overview: To save Littlebark from the rising tide of trash, Harvey becomes the superhero his town needs.

videos.title: Icky Chicky
videos.overview: Having outgrown his favorite baby toy, Harvey gives it to Foo, but letting go is harder than he thought.

videos.title: Buds Before Studs
videos.overview: When Princess claims Foo as her boyfriend, Fee and Claire team up to undo the disaster.

videos.title: Le Corn Maze ... OF DOOM!
videos.overview: After the kids claim that last year's Halloween festival maze wasn't at all scary, Les Squirrels make this year's maze the scariest ever.

videos.title: Harvey Isn't Scary
videos.overview: While the children follow a Halloween tradition of telling scary stories, Harvey can't seem to scare anyone with his stories.

videos.title: Harvey Fights Kratz
videos.overview: After Harvey and Kratz get into a minor disagreement, they're told the only way they can remain friends is to fight it out like dudes.

videos.title: Yampions
videos.overview: It's board game night at the Beaks' house. Harvey teams up with his father against his mother and the twins.

videos.title: Barkball
videos.overview: When a little league coach rejects Harvey and his friends, they're determined to prove him wrong in a winner-take-all game.

videos.title: Junior Squealers
videos.overview: Fee is the culprit of a crime-wave in Littlebark, and Harvey has to figure out if it's better to be true to the rules or to your friends.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: Harvey is worried living outside is unsafe and insists the twins move in with him.

videos.title: Steamgate
videos.overview: Feeling like no one in town shares his interests, Moff builds a portal to another dimension.

videos.title: Yeti Ready
videos.overview: Afraid that he can't protect his family from an imaginary yeti, Irving goes to Rooter's survivalist family for help.

videos.title: Terrybear
videos.overview: Technobear is shocked to discover his real name is Terrybear. With no idea who he really is anymore, he decides to re-invent himself.

videos.title: Bark Kart
videos.overview: The kids of Littlebark enter an epic go-kart race.

videos.title: Wade Is Cooler Than Dade
videos.overview: Dade tries to change to be cool like his younger brother Wade.

videos.title: King of the Castle
videos.overview: The kids build an awesome castle out of garbage, but must keep Princess from knocking it down.

videos.title: Foofee
videos.overview: Fee and Foo have a secret language just for the two of them, but Foo feels betrayed when Fee shares it with Harvey.

videos.title: Why Are You Even Friends?
videos.overview: Dade loses it when he has doubts about whether or not he and Harvey are totally best friends.

videos.title: Alone
videos.overview: Unable to find anyone to play with for the day, Harvey has to find a way to have fun all by himself.

videos.title: Foo Shoes
videos.overview: Foo's handmade mud shoes become popular in Littlebark, until Les Squirrels steal his idea by making knock-offs.

videos.title: The Punishment
videos.overview: Wracked with guilt over accidentally breaking a plate, Harvey tries to find a big enough punishment.

videos.title: Arbor Day
videos.overview: Arbor Day, Piri Piri's favorite day, comes under attack from historical accuracy.

videos.title: Double Digits
videos.overview: Harvey believes that he'll become a boring adult when he turns 10, so he tries to cancel his birthday.

videos.title: Fee and Foo's First Birthday
videos.overview: The twins have never had a birthday, so they throw the biggest bash Littlebark has ever seen.

videos.title: The New Bugaboo
videos.overview: Thinking his family is big enough, Harvey gives his baby sister away.

videos.title: The Case of the Missing Pancake
videos.overview: Harvey's grandparents are the suspects of a despicable crime: pancake theft.

videos.title: Kathy with a K
videos.overview: Harvey meets Kathy, a shy girl who LOVES leaves, and tries to find her some like-minded friends, but his efforts misfire.

videos.title: Harvey's Pet
videos.overview: Wanting to show he's responsible enough to have a pet, Harvey adopts a plant and treats it like a puppy.

videos.title: Life Debt
videos.overview: Wanting to show he's responsible enough to have a pet, Harvey adopts a plant and treats it like a puppy.

videos.title: The Feelings
videos.overview: Irving sets up a demonstrative camping trip in hopes of connecting with his stone-faced father.

videos.title: Bag of Naughty
videos.overview: When Harvey, Fee and Foo find a bag of magical fireworks, Jeremy warns them to get rid of it fast, but it's a challenge because it gives temptation to play with the fireworks.

videos.title: Steampunks (1)
videos.overview: Harvey imagines himself and his friends in a magical steampunk world, but things come crashing down when Harvey is blamed for breaking a floating city

videos.title: Steampunks (2)
videos.overview: Harvey imagines himself and his friends in a magical steampunk world, but things come crashing down when Harvey is blamed for breaking a floating city

videos.title: Mr. and Mrs. Borks
videos.overview: When Harvey's parents decide to get remarried, Fee and Harvey plan crazy bachelor and bachelorette parties before the big day.

videos.title: Operation Peanut Butter
videos.overview: Harvey leads the squirrels on a daring heist in order to help them regain their confidence as outlaws.

videos.title: Little Littlebark
videos.overview: Harvey makes doll replicas of the citizens of Littlebark and believes they have magical powers.

videos.title: Repo Fee
videos.overview: Randl takes Fee under his wing and teaches her the family business.

videos.title: Stalemates
videos.overview: Fee and Foo try to prove they are the strongest folks in Littlebark by entering an arm-wrestling competition.

videos.title: Technoscare
videos.overview: When Technobear decides he's too cool for trick-or-treating, he's visited by three Halloween spirits that remind him of the true meaning of the holiday.

videos.title: It's Christmas, You Dorks!
videos.overview: Old Man Winter makes a musical wonderland out of Littlebark Grove.

videos.title: Rockbark Rocks
videos.overview: Harvey thinks he is ready to rock out at his first concert, but is he really ready?

videos.title: Ocean Promotion
videos.overview: When the Lake Spirit gets a promotion, Harvey tries to convince him that Littlebark is too great of a town to leave.

videos.title: Jeremy: Defender of the Forest
videos.overview: An unspeakable evil from Jeremy's heroic past resurfaces, causing him to become a warrior once more.

videos.title: Princess Harvey
videos.overview: When Princess becomes Harvey for the day, she fights tooth and nail to keep his loving family all to herself.

videos.title: The Split
videos.overview: When Dade and the twins have an epic fight, Harvey is torn between the 2 warring sides.

videos.title: The Dade
videos.overview: Dade gets a sandwich named after him and finally feels special.

videos.title: Secret Gordon
videos.overview: Harvey and Piri Piri find a secret garden, but Piri Piri wants to keep it a secret.

videos.title: The Unknown Comic
videos.overview: A comic comes to Littlebark by an unknown artist. Who made it?

videos.title: The Blister
videos.overview: When Fee and Foo are forced to volunteer at a retirement home, Fee bonds with an old guy named Blister with an interesting life before he was put in the retirement home.

videos.title: The Bad Seed
videos.overview: After Michelle is not allowed to watch a scary movie, she still wants to watch it by any means necessary.

videos.title: The Ballad of Muesli and Jangles
videos.overview: When Harvey and the twins are sick, Irving tells them how he met Miriam with some creative and weird improvements.

videos.title: Floo-id
videos.overview: After an incident, Foo becomes a stretchy guy!

videos.title: Hug Life
videos.overview: In order to be part of Blister's Greasers gang, Harvey tries to prove himself worthy – his way.

videos.title: On the Fence
videos.overview: Upon finding a fence, Harvey devises it as a way to unite his community. However, it ends up doing the opposite.

videos.title: The Late Late Afternoon Show with Harvey Beaks
videos.overview: Harvey hosts a talk show in his living room but goes off-script when learning a terrible truth.

videos.title: The Grunicorn
videos.overview: The kids are on a race to find a rare magical creature and the winner is granted their heart's desire.

videos.title: Photo Finished
videos.overview: Miriam gets into a social media war to prove Harvey and Michelle are the cutest kids in Littlebark.

videos.title: Squashbuckling
videos.overview: Randl wants an old boat for scrap, but it's infested with children pretending they're pirates.

videos.title: Later, Dingus
videos.overview: Miriam gets a call from the nursing home Blister is from to tell Fee he died. At first, she thinks it's a joke, but when he doesn't show up on the prank, she learns it the hard way.

videos.title: Hair to Help
videos.overview: Tara has lost her creative inspiration for hairstyling, so Piri Piri and Harvey help her to rediscover her passion.

videos.title: Break the Lake
videos.overview: There's a new lake spirit in town who tries her best, but she's a hot mess.

videos.title: The Amazing Harvey
videos.overview: Harvey becomes a magician, but keeping the secrets behind the magic turns into a great burden.

videos.title: Princess Wants a Mom
videos.overview: Princess orders her dad to start dating again so she can have a new mom.

videos.title: Rage Against the Michelle
videos.overview: Michelle wrecks Harvey's stuff, so Harvey must cope with an unfamiliar emotion.

videos.title: Grand Motel
videos.overview: When Harvey and his family check in to a motel, he gains a new life's purpose, going down the pool's water slide.

videos.title: Missing Harvey
videos.overview: Harvey's away for one day and his friends can't cope with his absence.

videos.title: Leaf It to Kathy
videos.overview: Kathy hosts an online advice show and helps Kratz find his love.

videos.title: A Child's Guide to Surviving in the Wild
videos.overview: The boys get lost in the woods and learn how to survive, Rooter-style.

videos.title: The End & The Beginning
videos.overview: Fee and Foo are reunited with their parents, and their lives and their friendship with Harvey changes forever.
